derivation: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H205 (אָוֶן); son of my sorrow;
def: Ben-Oni, the original name of Benjamin

occurrences.text: And it came to pass, as her soul was in departing, (for she died) that she called his name Ben–oni: but his father called him Benjamin.
